_comment: THE BOOTSTRAP FOR NETHERITE (#249). A forging die is the tool a drop forge presses metal
against - the pattern lives in the die, which is what a smithing template is. So this is not
an analogy, it is the same object doing the same job, and that is the standard the material
It teaches rather than drops. A die you found is worn out; what survives is the SHAPE of it,
which is knowledge, and knowledge is this mod's whole thesis.
Prybar rather than knife: it is a solid steel block and the pattern plate comes off it.
Weights and counts are first-pass; #36 owns them.

DECLARED teaches, not a teaching pool. A pool teaches whichever ITEM it drew, and the blueprint here is recompile:netherite_upgrade, which has no item behind it - a pool would have quietly taught 'steel_offcut' instead and left the chain decorative. Four fragments, so it takes four finds rather than one lucky one, the same treatment the Pump got in #160.
